_comment: Ticket Lifecycle Manifest — machine-readable folder registry. Build.py reads this to scaffold tickets/ structure and generate supervisor routing tables. NOT a pipeline manifest (we don't move tickets between folders via scripts — supervisors read frontmatter). Add custom folders by appending to the 'folders' array; run build.py --force to regenerate.

folders.label: inbox
folders.purpose: Proposed work — not yet committed to. Tickets and epic proposals live here until triaged.

folders.label: todo
folders.purpose: Actively in-flight work. One git worktree per epic. Standalone tickets worked inline.
folders.who_puts_tickets_here: Epic-supervisor or worktree-agent (for epics); human (for standalones)
folders.when_tickets_move_out: When complete: sub-tickets move to done/ within the epic; epic moves to 99_done

folders.label: done
folders.purpose: Archived finished epics and standalone tickets. Read-only — kept for history.
folders.when_tickets_move_out: Never (archive is permanent; deletions are deliberate housekeeping)

folders.label: rejected
folders.purpose: Decided-against work items. Kept for historical context; not deleted.

virtual_statuses.name: in_progress
virtual_statuses.description: Ticket is actively being worked on by an agent or human.

virtual_statuses.name: in_review
virtual_statuses.description: Ticket is in the pr-reviewer or commit phase.

virtual_statuses.name: blocked
virtual_statuses.description: Ticket is waiting for a dependency or human input.

virtual_statuses.name: deferred
virtual_statuses.description: Deliberately paused — not rejected, not active. Will resume later.

status_transitions.trigger: All agents sign off, commit and PR phases complete
Dependency unmet or user input required

_extensibility_guide: To add a custom folder (e.g. 05_qa): append a folder entry with a unique path and label. Update routing_symbol and allowed_statuses. Run build.py --force --target-dir <project-root> to create the folder and regenerate READMEs.
